column1: # Nathan White's own classifier inventory, written by hand with citations.
# Copied unchanged (apart from this header) from classifiers_sources.tsv in
# scripts/merge_nw_classifiers.py merges it into classifiers.tsv; rerun it when
#   DIALECT   WH, GM, or CO for a form common to both varieties.
#   GLOSS     his gloss: cl: a classifier, mw: a measure word, vcl: a verbal
#   CATEGORY  his subclass, as in White (2021) ch. 7, e.g. mensural:time.
#             for forms from his field notes.
#   NOTE      sandhi form, variant, or the source of a borrowing.
#   White, Nathan M. 2019. [chapter on Hmong classifiers -- full reference to come]
#   White, Nathan M. 2021. The Hmong language of North Queensland. PhD thesis,
